description: You have a decision with a real conflict in it. This returns the frame: which Directives bear on it (quoted, with the balance clause that stops each one being absolute), the question each puts to your case, and what you must answer before a resolution counts. It does not answer for you — nothing here will tell you what to conclude. Nothing is stored.

directives.description: optional: directive-1..7 if you already know which are in tension

question.description: the decision you are facing, in a sentence or two

name: deliberate
title: Frame a hard question
